business_summary: Grand Power Logistics Group Limited, an investment holding company, provides freight forwarding services in Europe, Asia, North America, South America, Oceania, Africa, and internationally. The company offers air and ocean export and import freight forwarding services, including arranging shipments upon receipt of booking instructions from its customers; and obtaining cargo space from cargo space suppliers, such as airlines, shipping liners, and other freight forwarders; and preparing documentation comprising customs clearance from origin of consignment. It also provides related ancillary logistics services, including cargo pick-up, cargo handling at ports, and local transportation services; and warehousing related services, including repackaging, labelling, palletizing, customs clearance, and warehousing services. Grand Power Logistics Group Limited was incorporated in 2018 and is headquartered in Kowloon, Hong Kong.
business_summary_ko: 투자 지주 회사인 Grand Power Logistics Group Limited는 유럽, 아시아, 북미, 남미, 오세아니아, 아프리카 및 국제적으로 화물 운송 서비스를 제공합니다. The company offers air and ocean export and import freight forwarding services, including arranging shipments upon receipt of booking instructions from its customers; 항공사, 선박 정기선, 기타 화물 운송업자와 같은 화물 공간 공급업체로부터 화물 공간을 확보하는 것; 및 화물 발송지로부터의 통관을 포함하는 서류 준비. 또한 화물 픽업, 항구에서의 화물 처리, 현지 운송 서비스 등 관련 보조 물류 서비스도 제공합니다. 재포장, 라벨링, 팔레타이징, 통관 및 창고 서비스를 포함한 창고 관련 서비스. Grand Power Logistics Group Limited는 2018년에 설립되었으며 홍콩 구룡에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
